design.matched_controls: Render text, Word and native PDF without dropping source characters. Test actual references, an ordinary appendix after references, too few entries, a heading followed by prose and a mixed list.
design.sources: Four dated article sources per publisher from the retained JATS archives. Pin article bytes and DOI. Use their initial body paragraphs and six of their labeled bibliography records, rendered from the same JATS fields.
design.utility: The entire qualified reference section should be excluded in the bibliography case only. On those cases, the retained normalized text and all source-map offsets must equal the body control.
